chapter_seo_title: Han Li Reveals the Deadly Secret of Blood Sacrifice (Chapter 315 Recap)
chapter_meta_description: Han Li casually debunks the Black Fiend Cult leader’s cultivation level using forbidden blood sacrifice lore. Meanwhile, the wounded bald-headed man reports back to a frosty ally. The waiting game begins.
og_title: The Dark History of Blood Sacrifice – A Mortal’s Journey Chapter 315
og_description: Han Li’s exposition on the two types of blood sacrifice dismantles the cult leader’s mystique. Plus, a peek into the cold hall of the imperial palace.
twitter_title: Chapter 315: Han Li schools everyone on blood sacrifice and reveals why the cult won’t run.
twitter_description: The cult leader is stuck in a yin cave and can’t flee. Meanwhile, the bald survivor gets a chilly welcome from “Ice Fiend.”

lore_anchors.definition: A forbidden cultivation art that absorbs another cultivator’s essence and power for rapid advancement. The original version permanently locks the user at Foundation Establishment; the later “soul sacrifice” version is safer but kept secret.

A refined version of blood sacrifice that targets a cultivator’s soul and origin spirit rather than their essence. It avoids the core formation bottleneck and backlash but remains restricted to high-level demonic sect members.
A forced demonic state that a cultivator can activate to vastly increase power at the cost of severe origin energy damage. It functions as a last-resort escape tool, not a sustainable combat mode.
A place of concentrated yin energy, often located in geomantically significant spots. Cultivating in such a cave can accelerate progress but also ties the cultivator to a fixed location.
A group of four rogue cultivators allied with Han Li during the Black Fiend Cult incident. They are practical, battle-tested, and show clear hierarchy among themselves.
A core member of the Black Fiend Cult, stationed in the imperial palace’s cold hall. He speaks with a frosty, detached demeanor and bears a sour envy toward more talented peers.
